definitions.explanation: Along or facing the sea — the strip of land running beside the coast. Often used attributively with の.

examples.japanese: {海沿|うみぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ドライブ→ドライブ：03866_doraibu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I drove along the coastal road.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海沿|うみぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This town is located along the coast.

examples.japanese: {海沿|うみぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まって→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧、⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: We stayed at a seaside hotel and watched the sunrise from the window.

notes:
Made of ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) + {沿|ぞ}い (along). Used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {海沿|うみぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海沿|うみぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: coastal road
- {海沿|うみぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: seaside town
- {海沿|うみぞ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run or drive along the coast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{川沿|かわぞ}い→川沿い：03046_kawazoi⟧: along a river — the same 〜{沿|ぞ}い pattern
- ⟦{海辺|うみべ}→海辺：05498_umibe⟧: seaside; beach — the place itself, rather than 'running along' it
